meta.purpose: PR R1.3/R2.4/R3.3 -- matched *relative* weight perturbation vs the archived equal-sigma protocol, to test whether Vision is still more fragile once ||dW||_F/||W||_F is matched across the two towers

archive_injector.rule: for encoder.layers tensors only; skip names containing 'layernorm' or 'embedding' (the archived skip test is case-insensitive substring, so 'layer_norm1' is NOT skipped); noise = randn_like(p) * sigma * p.std()

data.preprocess: CLIPProcessor (openai/clip-vit-base-patch32) image processor, batch-precomputed once and reused byte-identically by every condition; no random augmentation anywhere in this script
data.text: raw caption #0 of each image, CLIPProcessor padding=True truncation=True max_length=77

metrics.retrieval: R@k i2t/t2i over the full 1000-sample evaluation set (src.gap_metrics / this script)
metrics.CG_DG: src/gap_metrics.py::GapTracker.compute -- CG = ||mu_I-mu_T||_2, DG = sqrt(CG^2 + ||sigma_I-sigma_T||^2), sigma = per-dimension std

protocols.rel_uniform: ||dW_i||_F = r * ||W_inj||_F / sqrt(n) for every injected tensor
protocols.abs_std: archived injector: dW_i = sigma * std(W_i) * randn
protocols.abs_raw: dW_i = sigma * randn, sigma = r * rms(vision injected tensors); the same sigma for every tensor of both towers

definition.ratio_of_drops: mean drop of the vision tower / mean drop of the text tower at the same perturbation level (positive = vision more degraded)
definition.paired_ratio: per-seed vision drop / text drop at the same level; pooled mean/sd over seeds and over levels with mean drop >= 1% in both towers
definition.matched_drop_budget_ratio: relative budget r (or sigma for abs_*) needed to reach a given R@1 drop, per seed, by log-x linear-y interpolation over the level grid; ratio = text / vision
definition.pooled_ratio_levels: pools over (seed, level) pairs: all_levels = everything; levels_ge_1pct_both = both tower drops >= 1%; levels_nonsaturated = both >= 1% and both <= 90% -- the headline rule, which excludes the saturated R@1 floor where any ratio collapses towards 1
